# Calm Magic — Paracosm

> Calm Magic is a methodology and platform by Paracosm for building Learning Organizations: AI systems mastery, relational intelligence, and a 64-tile compass for navigating change. Created by Jonathan Belisle.

Paracosm helps executives, founders, and innovators move from chaos to coherence through the seven phases of Calm Magic — GLITCH, DRIFT, TUNE, LOVE, MAGIC, CALM, FREE — combined with agentic AI tools, residencies, and a forthcoming book.
